link_power_management_states.description: All lanes up; PCS locked + FEC-aligned; MAC streaming at 800 Gb/s.
Energy Efficient Ethernet Low-Power Idle (Clause-78-class) if supported at 800G; PHY analog deep-sleep when the MAC has no traffic.
Per-lane transmitter disable via the Clause-45 PMA/PMD MMD for module power-down / eye-safety.
SerDes re-train + PCS re-lock + FEC re-align before link-up.

low_power_modes_summary.EEE_LPI: Per-direction LPI; PHY analog low-power on idle.
low_power_modes_summary.PMD_TX_disable: Per-lane TX off; rest of PHY may remain configured.

device_states_d0_d3_analog.description: BMCR.Power Down = 0 and Isolate = 0. PHY analog + digital fully on. Equivalent to ACPI D0.
BMCR.Isolate = 1. Equivalent to D2 — PHY logic on, MII drivers off.
BMCR.Power Down = 1. Most PHY analog gated off. MDIO responsive. Equivalent to D3hot.
RESET# asserted. All PHY logic in reset. Equivalent to D3cold.

auxiliary_power_for_wake_on_lan.Vaux_support: Implementation-defined. Many PHYs accept a separate Vaux rail so they can stay alive in D3cold and emit a Magic Packet wake-up event to the host (Wake-on-LAN).
auxiliary_power_for_wake_on_lan.Vaux_usage_hint: Required for any deployment that must wake the system on receipt of a designated frame (Magic Packet) while main power is off.

pause_flow_control_summary.PAUSE_direction: 802.3x symmetric PAUSE + 802.1Qbb priority-based flow control (PFC); full-duplex only.

fields.notes: 800GbE power management centers on the SerDes + optics (the dominant power consumers) and on optional EEE LPI. Pluggable modules expose power-class + low-power-mode control via CMIS. Wake-on-LAN-class features are NIC/host concerns, not part of 802.3df.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
